text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Aptitude.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Innate skeletal structure, muscle 
quality... Umamusume, in particular, are 
heavily influenced by their natural-born 
traits."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the world of Umamusume racing, whether 
a course suits your aptitude or not can 
mean the difference between 1st and dead 
last.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of course, there is a possibility that 
training can change aptitudes, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There may be times when you begrudge even 
the time spent making an effort.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...An athlete's prime is brief, and 
nothing can ever replace it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As an Umamusume Trainer, how should I 
handle her natural aptitude and help her 
truly shine?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That is a fundamental question that haunts 
every Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With summer behind us, we spent this day 
making our final adjustments for the 
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll go finish warming up 
first. Just a light 600m run on the turf 
to ease into it...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: No, something is coming from over there...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: K-King-chaaan! What should I do~?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Special Week? What are you doing here...?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Special Week! Your fierce run in that 
Derby was truly inspiring!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Reporter
text_block_list.text:
You're running in the next Kikuka Sho as 
well, right! Are you aiming for the title 
of the strongest horse girl?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whoa. Ev-Everyone, please calm down~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... I'm sorry, King-chan. I-I'm just 
not used to this kind of interview...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
W-W-W-What should I do!? What in the world 
am I supposed to say!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...All you have to do is answer what was 
asked, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Special Week! Who do you consider your 
rival?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: R-Rivals?! Ri-Rival... Uh, uuuuh?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"—Special Week-san. It has been a long 
time since I last saw a performance that 
captivated people so deeply."

text_block_list.name: Stall Tourists in Line
text_block_list.text:
"...I really like Special Week's 
straightforward, unrelenting grit."

text_block_list.name: Tourist in Swimsuit
text_block_list.text:
Me too, me too! Plus, they've got an eye 
for talent! Keeping an eye on Seiun Sky 
and all!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Is it Seiun Sky after all, widely favored 
for the long distance?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sei-chan, is it?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I did hear from Sei-chan that she's 
entering both the Kikuka Sho and the Tenno 
Sho (Spring), but...

text_block_list.name: Press Corps
text_block_list.text: Oooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
What's this?! A declaration of rivalry 
from Seiun Sky?! Boy, things are heating 
up!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what!? K-King-chan!? W-W-Wait!? 
Don't leave me alone!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...You'll be fine. You've got the hang of 
handling interviews now."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, Trainer. Let's finish our 
warm-up."
choice_data_list: Was it really okay to leave them alone?
Was it okay to leave them alone?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine. I have more important things 
to do anyway."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Don't waste any time either. ...The 
Kikuka Sho is right around the corner."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And King Halo sprinted off for a 600-meter 
turf warm-up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (――SWOOSH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's accelerating before our very eyes. 
Her true weapon really is—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... How was it? My run 
today...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I have what it takes too... I won't lose 
to Sky-san or Special Week-san...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching her run today, and seeing how 
she's run up until now, there is one thing 
I'm certain of.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her weapon is, without a doubt, that 
explosive burst of speed. Not pacing 
herself to save her legs, but unleashing 
everything in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That was a talent destined to shine in 
short-distance sprints, rather than the 
long-distance Kikuka Sho—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...What's with that conflicted look on 
your face? If you have something on your 
mind, just spit it out.
choice_data_list:
Are you sure you want to run in the Kikuka 
Sho?
Are you really okay with the Kikuka Sho?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...It's fine. After all, the Triple Crown 
path is the true royal road.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
As a first-class Umamusume, it's only 
right that I pursue the Triple Crown 
route.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She certainly has an aptitude for medium 
and long distances as well. On top of 
that—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
—Besides, it's only natural that I have 
the talent to shine in the Classics.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I need to be an Umamusume who can run 
anywhere—medium or long distance—and shine 
brightest on the Triple Crown path!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"That's what is necessary to be recognized 
as a first-rate Umamusume...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Her mother was truly an Umamusume who 
succeeded on the world stage. That is 
precisely why what she carries as her 
daughter is so heavy."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet she and her mother are different. 
There is always the possibility she might 
shine elsewhere—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Please, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I understand that, too. But I can't give 
you the right to talk about it.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I want to win the Kikuka Sho. I want to 
leave my mark on the Classic Triple Crown 
route.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
After all, I came to this academy fully 
prepared for what lay ahead.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
—That I would make Mother acknowledge my 
talent, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...After that, I couldn't say anything 
more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ensuring her trembling legs wouldn't 
collapse underneath her, preparations for 
the Kikuka Sho moved forward.
